cases.name: baseline
cases.reason: Unmodified actual engine source compiles before any injected dirty-boundary program.

cases.name: release
cases.reason: Actual generic installed storage assembles dirty views, actual reserve/cancel signatures and scoped Sync reader, then releases borrows and re-splits; sealed permit installer signatures type-check without minting authority.

cases.name: old_reader_consume
cases.reason: A live original clean reader prevents consuming its installed namespace.

cases.name: storage_drop
cases.reason: The actual storage/fence owner outlives a bound dirty pool.

cases.name: core_drop
cases.reason: The exact external core outlives its bound pool.

cases.name: frames_reborrow
cases.reason: Bound registration retains the exclusive frame-wrapper slice borrow.

cases.name: payload_reborrow
cases.reason: A borrowed DirtyFrame payload cannot be mutably aliased during the binding.

cases.name: workspace_reborrow
cases.reason: The bound writer retains its real98304-byte operation workspace.

cases.name: bound_move
cases.reason: A live writer/read split borrows the stable bound owner.

cases.name: bound_resplit
cases.reason: Only one field-disjoint writer/read split is live at once.

cases.name: owner_reborrow
cases.reason: An actual dirty content guard retains the exclusive operation Owner.

cases.name: pins_reuse
cases.reason: Consuming dirty pins into an actual read guard transfers their ownership once.

cases.name: read_mutable
cases.reason: An actual read guard exposes only immutable page bytes.

cases.name: read_sync
cases.reason: The actual dirty read guard is not Sync even though its reader view is Sync.

cases.name: write_sync
cases.reason: The actual dirty version/content write guard cannot be shared across threads.

cases.name: raw_lsn
cases.reason: A raw LSN cannot substitute for a sealed successful-stage install permit.

cases.name: permit_private
cases.reason: Only the actual producer module may construct the sealed exact-core/after-image permit.

cases.name: permit_clone
cases.reason: The sealed install permit is not Clone.
